✓ Practice scenarios

Helping a nervous first-time flyer

I would acknowledge their concern, ask what would help and explain the next step in plain language. I’d check in again when duties allow.

Responding to a seating concern

I would listen, explain what I can check and coordinate with the crew lead before offering any change. I’d return with an update, even if a move isn’t possible.

Handling an unavailable meal request

I would acknowledge the request and check what alternatives are available. For allergy concerns, I would follow airline procedures and consult the crew lead before making any assurances.
